scope: Pre-declaration development capture; selected inputs and observed executable identity only. This is not a release seal or a complete build/environment reconstruction.

selected_inputs.coverage: Retained capture-time hashes of Rust sources, selected fixtures, root Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml. Eleven retired source paths were removed after capture; surviving hashes are unchanged. Package manifests, all transitive inputs and the full compiler environment were not sealed.

capture_harness.method: Before declaring Owned<T>, AccountDetails, NftData or RwaData identities, record compiler type names, active serialize/deserialize schema hashes, exact bare payloads, advertised flags, complete frames and JSON. Root projections are recorded separately from nominal container identities. The temporary writer was then removed; the permanent test reads the frozen fixture.

layout_correction_included: Nested tuples inherit explicit enclosing flags, including zero. Metadata entries stream using canonical length-prefixed fields and advertise checked packed offsets. Earlier malformed captures are not accepted fixtures.
limitations: The artifact and full execution log are local ignored build outputs; their observed digests are retained here.
This manifest records selected pre-declaration file hashes, not their source bytes. It cannot by itself reconstruct the dirty working tree.
No complete feature matrix, cross-platform, release, build-memory or native qualification is claimed.
